clues.text: This coaster climbs to a height of 90 feet, reaches a top speed of 44 mph, and features no inversions.
Built by the renowned manufacturer Bolliger & Mabillard, this ride made its official debut in 2026.
Thrill-seekers can take a spin on this coaster in the state of Texas.
Upon opening, this attraction was advertised as the tallest inverted family coaster in North America.
The ride's name suggests the sudden and aggressive attack of a sharp-toothed predatory marine fish.

evidence.quote: '''Barracuda Strike''' is an [[inverted]] [[roller coaster]] currently [[operating]] at [[SeaWorld San Antonio]] in San Antonio, Texas, USA.
Manufactured by Bolliger & Mabillard, the ride stands 90 feet (27 m) tall and was advertised as the tallest inverted family coaster in North America.
